title: Expose onBlur, onFocus, onKeyDown events out of SearchBox
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**
Feature for SearchBox

**Feature: What is your use case for such a feature?**
All provided features are good for me, I don't need to create my custom one.
- I use this SearchBox for a Dashboard page, and also Auto Complete.
```js
<Layout>
  <Header>
    <SearchBox />
    <AutocompleteResults />
  </Header>
  <Content />
</Layout>
```
- Actually, I don't need react-autosuggest, as I tried your examples.

**Feature: What is your proposed API entry? The new option to add? What is the behavior?**
When using this Search Box, I need to know whether users focus/ blur/ press keys (Up, Down, Enter, ...) to implement my own AutoComplete features.
The solution could be inputProps (type = object) property.

**What project are you opening an issue for?**
- react-instantsearch

**What is the version you are using? Always use the latest one before opening a bug issue.**
3.1.0

What do you think @vvo?
Like https://github.com/vinhlh/instantsearch.js/commit/14cca027cc49e8d3ee23aba02f151e07ac2f61c1
